paper_record.title: Layer-Dependent Vibrational and Optical Properties of $\mathrm{Mo}{0.58}\mathrm{W}{0.42}\mathrm{Se}_2$ Alloy
paper_record.abstract: Semiconducting Mo$_x$W$_{1-x}$Se$_2$ alloys provide a versatile platform for tailoring the optical properties of two-dimensional materials through both composition and layer thickness. Here, we systematically investigate mechanically exfoliated Mo$_{0.58}$W$_{0.42}$Se$_2$ flakes ranging from monolayer (1L) to nine layers by combining Raman scattering (RS), photoluminescence (PL), reflectance contrast (RC) spectroscopy, and first-principles phonon calculations. Thirteen RS peaks are identified, including the low-frequency interlayer shear mode, whose thickness dependence is well described by a linear-chain model, yielding an interlayer force constant of $K_s=(2.996\pm0.015)\times10^{19}$ N m$^{-3}$. PL measurements reveal a crossover from the direct-bandgap 1L to indirect-bandgap multilayers. The thickness evolution of the indirect optical transition is quantitatively reproduced using a quantum-confinement model, yielding an out-of-plane reduced effective mass of $μ_\perp=0.75 m_0$. RC spectroscopy reveals four excitonic resonances. While the A and B excitons associated with the $K^\pm$ valleys remain nearly independent of layer thickness, the higher-energy C and D resonances originating from the band-nesting regions exhibit pronounced redshifts, reflecting substantial thickness-induced modifications of the electronic band structure. These results establish comprehensive spectroscopic fingerprints of flake thickness, interlayer coupling, and electronic structure in Mo$_x$W$_{1-x}$Se$_2$ alloys and provide a reliable, non-destructive framework for their optical characterization.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文结合喇曼光谱、光致发光、反射对比光谱与第一性原理计算，系统揭示了Mo0.58W0.42Se2合金从单层到九层的声子振动及电子结构演化规律。
one_sentence_summary.en: This work systematically investigates the layer-dependent vibrational and optical properties of Mo0.58W0.42Se2 alloy flakes from monolayer to nine layers by combining spectroscopy and first-principles calculations.

problem.zh: 缺乏对二维三元MoWSe2合金在不同层数下的声子振动（特别是低频层间剪切模）、带隙演化及能带嵌套激子响应的系统表征与物理理解。
problem.en: Lack of a systematic understanding and spectroscopic characterization of vibrational modes, bandgap crossover, and band-nesting excitons as a function of layer thickness in ternary MoWSe2 alloys.

approach.zh: 对1层至9层机械剥离样品开展喇曼散射、光致发光和反射对比光谱测量，结合第一性原理声子计算，并利用线性链模型和量子限制模型进行定量分析。
approach.en: Performed Raman scattering, photoluminescence, and reflectance contrast spectroscopy on 1L to 9L exfoliated flakes, combined with DFT phonon calculations, linear-chain model, and quantum-confinement model analysis.

main_takeaway.zh: 指认了13个喇曼模式并获得层间剪切力常数；证实了从单层直接带隙到多层间接带隙的演变，并发现能带嵌套区域的C、D激子共振随层数增加呈现显著红移。
main_takeaway.en: Identified 13 Raman features, determined the interlayer force constant from shear modes, demonstrated the direct-to-indirect bandgap crossover, and revealed strong thickness-induced redshifts of C and D band-nesting excitons.

why_it_matters.zh: 为二维过渡金属硫属化合物合金的层数无损鉴定、层间耦合强度评估以及能带调控提供了完备的光学指纹与分析框架。
why_it_matters.en: Provides comprehensive non-destructive optical fingerprints and a quantitative framework for layer thickness determination, interlayer coupling evaluation, and band structure engineering in 2D TMD alloys.

reason.zh: 系统厘清了MoWSe2合金中层数变化对晶格动力学、层间相互作用、能带转变及高能激子特性的影响机制。
reason.en: Systematically clarifies the mechanisms by which layer thickness modulates lattice dynamics, interlayer coupling, bandgap crossover, and high-energy excitonic transitions in MoWSe2 alloys.

reason.zh: 该研究对二维合金材料的声子谱与激子性质进行了深入且系统的基础物理表征，非常符合PRB的期刊定位。
reason.en: The paper presents a comprehensive and detailed fundamental physics study on phonon and excitonic properties of 2D alloys, well-aligned with PRB's scope.
